author: Epic Games
description:
In 2019, Jesse Faden entered the headquarters of the Federal Bureau of Control: The Oldest House. What followed was a chain of events that set Jesse as the new Director of the FBC, had her fighting an interdimensional resonance known as the Hiss, and most importantly, helped her find her long lost brother. Catch up with happened in CONTROL before CONTROL Resonant comes out.  

CONTROL Resonant arrives September 24, 2026, to the Epic Games Store. Pre-purchase now! https://epic.gm/control-resonant

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment.
